text:
jordan: quick note - spotted a reproducible app hang when using our AsyncClient initialized at module import + uvicorn with --reload. Seems related to event loop policy & asyncio.run mismatch.

liu: can you paste the repro? iirc --reload spawns a new process which might change the loop policy.

jordan: minimal repro below. start client on import, use client.generate from a handler, then ctrl-c. sometimes the process doesn't exit, shows pending tasks in logs.
```py
# server.py
from fastapi import FastAPI
from redwood_sdk import AsyncClient

app = FastAPI()
client = AsyncClient()  # starts background refresh + httpx AsyncClient

@app.get('/')
async def ping():
    return await client.generate('ping')

# run: uvicorn server:app --reload --loop asyncio
```

jordan: stack usually shows httpx awaiting in our retry/backoff and a couple of orphan tasks like _background_refresh_loop. ctrl-c -> SIGINT hangs because tasks aren't being cancelled or awaited properly.

evan: thanks. a few axes here: 1) import-time startup is anti-pattern for ASGI; 2) we don't set an explicit event loop policy in the client, so uvicorn's reloader can leave a different default loop, and 3) our retry logic re-attempts after CancelledError in some code paths.

liu: is this different from the issue maya filed earlier? sounds similar but the reload case is nasty because it forks and then replaces the process.

jordan: similar symptom but different trigger. here's a logging excerpt showing the orphan task IDs and the CancelledError trace:
```
Task exception was never retrieved
future: <Task finished name='Task-12' coro=_background_refresh_loop() done, defined at /usr/local/lib/python3.11/...>
concurrent.futures._base.CancelledError
  File ".../sdk/retries.py", line 87, in _do_request
    resp = await self._client.post(...)
  File ".../site-packages/httpx/_client.py", line 1500, in post
    return await self.request(...)
CancelledError
```

evan: for fixes: - add explicit start()/stop() lifecycle and document ASGI pattern; - make the refresher check an asyncio.Event and exit gracefully; - avoid retrying on CancelledError (let it propagate). Also consider exposing `async def lifespan(app):` helper for FastAPI to mount the client lifecyle.

liu: +1 on `lifespan` helper. sample API could be: `app.add_event_handler('startup', lambda: client.start())` but better to provide a ready-made `client.lifespan()` returning an async contextmanager. Then docs can show: `with client.lifespan():` in examples or `async with client.lifespan():` in ASGI startup.

jordan: typing nit: our AsyncClient.__aenter__/__aexit__ returns Any which breaks mypy in consumer code like `async with AsyncClient() as c:`. we should annotate them to return "AsyncClient" for better DX. also update .pyi stub.

evan: agreed. small PR plan: 1) add start/stop + lifespan asynccontextmanager; 2) change refresher to accept `stop_event: asyncio.Event | None` and check it inside loops; 3) make retry logic catch CancelledError only to re-raise immediately (no backoff); 4) add typing for context manager methods.

liu: can we also add a short note in the quickstart about not starting clients at import and show the recommended FastAPI pattern? new users keep doing import-time singletons.

jordan: yup i'll file an issue with the repro and attach logs. grabbing a smaller reproducible case that triggers consistently with --reload.

devx-bot: Created issue #3821: "async client: event loop policy/reload hang; start/stop + lifespan + typing fixes" and linked the repro.

jordan: thanks bot. would love to get a small patch for the next minor release. i'll volunteer to test PRs on a sample app with --reload on mac + linux. :thumbsup:
